Package com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.infrastructure.resourceserver

Class DocumentsApis

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.infrastructure.resourceserver.DocumentsApis
@Component public class DocumentsApis extends Object
Builds the documents client generated from the resource server's contract on top of a REST client that sends the access token of an authorized client (so the generated client's own authentication settings stay unused).

      public DocumentsApi forPrincipal(String registrationId, org.springframework.security.core.Authentication principal)
      Builds a documents client whose requests carry the access token of one authorized client.
      Parameters:
      registrationId - registration of the OAuth2 client that obtains the token.
